AuthorDetails.Name: Diplo
AuthorDetails.Description: Diplo is a UK Umbraco Gold Partner agency, founded by Dan Diplo, specialising in building, supporting and enhancing Umbraco solutions.

Description: Diplo Audit Log Viewer for Umbraco CMS lets Settings users view, search, filter, sort and export Content Log and Audit Trail data from the Umbraco backoffice. The Umbraco 17 version uses Lit/TypeScript backoffice extensions, Management API endpoints, node autocomplete and contextual workspace links.

RelatedPackages.Description: A collection of diagnostics and developer tools for the Umbraco backoffice.

Title: Diplo Audit Log Viewer
